result.final_text:
## What this letter says

You have an appointment for a 20-week anomaly scan.

You may bring one adult with you.

You do not need a full bladder for this scan.

Children cannot come into the scan room.

The scan cannot find every problem.

## What you need to do

1. Go to your appointment on Monday 11 January 2027 at 14:15.
2. Go to the Antenatal Clinic, Floor 1.
3. Call us at least 5 working days before if you need an interpreter.
4. Do not bring children into the scan room.

## Dates and medicines

Your 20-week anomaly scan: Monday 11 January 2027 at 14:15 in the Antenatal Clinic, Floor 1.

No medicines are mentioned in this letter.

## Questions to ask your doctor

1. What does anomaly scan mean?
2. How long will the appointment take?
3. When will I get my results?
4. What if I cannot come to this appointment?

## When to get urgent help

If you have any of these before your appointment, call the Maternity Assessment Unit (MAU) on 01632 960 456 straight away:
- any bleeding
- leaking fluid from your vagina
- severe tummy pain

This line is open 24 hours.

If you are worried and it is not an emergency, call NHS 111. In an emergency, call 999.

---
*This explanation was made by a computer program to help you read your letter. It may contain mistakes. It does not replace your doctor, nurse or pharmacist. Always follow the letter and ask them if anything is unclear.*
